text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Henceforth, there was naught to do for
myself and Doto but to offer
our utmost
unto our adorable yet cool Demon
Queen!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Preparations for Windy's Demonic Castle
at the Solefall Faire were
proceeding
smoothly, until...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm SO SOOORRY!
I-it's because I'm such a
dodo-brained
klutz!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, please calm down, Doto! It's okay,
just breathe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Lookie, we've got plenty of fabric,
needles, and thread! I had a
feeling
something like this could happen, so I
prepped extra!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But we've only got about a fifth of the
cloth left! I'm sorry, it's because I keep
ripping the fabric,
messing up my stitches, and
breaking the needles!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You're doing everything you can do to
help out, and that's enough!
Nay, more
than enough! Still...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps inexperienced cosplayers such as
ourselves... are not up to
the task of
weaving garments befitting the Demon
Queen's legion...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But any warrior at my command needs to
wear something ultra
cool—no buts!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, what has become of my
underlings? Hear me! I, Windy, have

made...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: H-have made?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Aaabsolutely zero progress! Sewing's hard!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Making these outfits is gonna take more
time than I thought... Digital! How much
longer do you think it'll take to finish
just
one?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My liege! I shall utilize Digitan Date
Divination in my calculation.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eureka! Please, lend me your ears. Whisper, whisper...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see, I see. So in other words...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: We're DEFINITELY not gonna make it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Windy... I know I'm the one dragging
us down, but if I may be so
bold...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should try to recruit more
people for our cause? W-with
some
assistance, we might be able to somehow...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...If there's anyone out there who really
wants to join my ranks, then
that's fine by
me. I don't wanna bother with the
searching, though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, b-but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've spoken—I don't wanna bother! This
conversation's finished, and
I'm gonna go
work over there!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine with just the two of you.
Everyone
else is just... They're just gonna make
fun
of me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...
Um, Digital? I have a teeny favor to
ask...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh! Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff! This ain't over!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hrrraugh! See ya later!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Agh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that lap was totally yours! Good
stuff, Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wa-heeey, today's just my day! But what's
up, Palmster? Vibes outta
whack?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, you got me. I've been training a
lot harder recently. Been
thinking I need
to give it my all for the autumn race
season, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's talking about the huge races
McQueen and Ryan are
prepping for, but
I've got my first fall race coming up too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna let them outclass me.
Nothin' to it but to win! You're gonna be
at the gates with me,
right? Can't afford to lose to you
either!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So right! I'ma stay winning, so you better
get ready!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: (Well, I say that, but... Hmm...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hrmmm... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's up, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the design, Digital! I hope
these flyers can really speak
to the
people...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Right? But color me surprised, Doto. To
think that you would go
behind our
queen's back to search for new recruits...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I would really hate to give up now.
I just
want all parts of Windy's
plan to live up to
her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but I really wouldn't be able to do this
without your help, hehe.
Thank you very
much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I mean, it's not like I did
anything special...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey, YO! What's good to know? ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Windy's Demonic Castle?! Sheesh, our
little goddess, wait, our
Demon Queen
ATE with this plan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so she's planned it for the Solefall
Faire? I guess that is coming
up soon. And
you said you were looking for some new
helping hands?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So ummm... Palmer, Helios... w-would
you consider...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Say less! This is gonna be lit, right,
Palmster?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?! H-Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh relax, relaaax! It's important to get
away from just runnin' all the
time, yeah?
Even you were saying how tired you were!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We're at Tracen Academy, remember? Not
some go-hard-or-go-home
burnout
bootcamp.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Which means student life is just as vital as racing life! So we gotta go all in! Or something!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios... But I'm...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And! I just know our gal Palmster's too
kind to say no when people
need her
help! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Urgh! ...Ahhh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Doto, Digital. You mind giving a message
to the Demon Queen? Tell
her she has two
new willing minions in the wings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes, right away!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waheeey! You're on fire today,
Palmster! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haha, geez. Thanks, Helios.
